maddeler.e:
استقدسوا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْدَسُوا (istaqdasū) /is.taq.da.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
# اُسْتُقْدِسُوا (ustuqdisū) /us.tuq.di.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
# اِسْتَقْدِسُوا (istaqdisū) /is.taq.di.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْدَسَ (istaqdasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
